name: Microgrid PCC power-factor controller
aliases: microgrids Microgrid voltage and reactive-power controls
summary: Controls the documented PCC power-factor objective using compatible resource reactive-power interfaces.
description: Controls the documented PCC power-factor objective using compatible resource reactive-power interfaces. Voltage and reactive-power control coordinate the AC operating condition of the microgrid resources. A voltage target, reactive-power target and power-factor target represent different control objectives and should have explicit ownership.

In an islanded microgrid, the assigned reference source supports bus voltage while other compatible resources share reactive demand according to the selected control method. Grid-connected operation can use a different objective at the PCC. For this reference, the drawing identifies “PCC active and reactive measurements” at the input and “Power-factor control demand” at the output. Low active power can affect target interpretation.
